summary: Heavy week. On AI/agents: OpenAI's internal Astra produced Lean-verified solutions to ten long-open math problems, Alibaba shipped the 2.4T-param Qwen3.8-Max, Meta entered the coding-agent race with Muse Code, and ACL/RSS best-paper results landed. We also caught up a real blind spot the tracker had missed: spec-driven / 'prompt-less' development (GitHub Spec Kit, Amazon Kiro, Tessl) is now a named 2026 movement, added as a curated sub-theme with watch-list players. Bio was eventful: FDA approved Moderna's mRNA flu shot (mFLUSIVA), CagriSema missed HbA1c non-inferiority vs tirzepatide, a second delayed child-death disclosure hit China's CRISPR/DMD trial, and Doudna's Aurora Therapeutics scrapped its lead program. Physical: CFS crossed $4B raised, ITER passed two-thirds of its core, Blue Origin traced the New Glenn explosion to a BE-4 valve, and Hot Chips previews Google's 8th-gen TPU and OpenAI's first in-house chip. Cross-cutting trend: frontier labs are racing to build their own silicon (Anthropic, Tesla/SpaceX Terafab, AMD/Taalas), and AI 'slop' is outpacing the gatekeeping meant to catch it.

highlights.detail: An internal Astra model produced Lean 4-verified solutions to ten math/CS problems unsolved for a decade or more (including the first explicit non-sofic group) for roughly $2,000 of inference compute; OpenAI published a 249-page report and machine-checkable certificates on GitHub Aug 1, 2026.

payload.claim: OpenAI's internal Astra model produced Lean 4-verified solutions to ten decade-plus-open math/CS problems for ~$2,000 of inference compute, with machine-checkable certificates published Aug 1, 2026.

highlights.title: Alibaba launches Qwen3.8-Max, 2.4T-param MoE, open weights imminent
highlights.detail: Released Aug 3, 2026, Qwen3.8-Max is a 2.4T-parameter MoE (95B active) with 1M-token context, priced well below GPT-5.6 ($2/$6 vs $5/$30 per M tokens, ~1/4 the cost); Alibaba says open weights plus a 27B sibling follow within a week.

payload.claim: Alibaba released Qwen3.8-Max (Aug 3, 2026), a 2.4T-param MoE (95B active) with 1M-token context at ~1/4 GPT-5.6 pricing ($2/$6 vs $5/$30 per M tokens), with open weights and a 27B sibling promised within a week.

highlights.title: Meta ships Muse Code, its first coding agent, with Muse Spark 1.2
highlights.detail: Meta Superintelligence Labs released Muse Code (Aug 5, 2026), a terminal-based coding agent with persistent background sub-agents and a replay-exact event log, paired with the coding-tuned Muse Spark 1.2 model.

payload.name: Meta Muse Code + Muse Spark 1.2

highlights.title: RSS 2026 finalist OAT enables anytime, coarse-to-fine robot actions
highlights.detail: 'Ordered Action Tokenization' (RSS 2026 Outstanding Paper finalist) tokenizes robot action chunks into a causally-ordered, prefix-decodable sequence so a VLA policy can act on the first few tokens for a fast coarse action or wait for a refined one; a companion paper (arXiv:2607.21670) validates it across three backbones and 60+ tasks.

payload.name: Ordered Action Tokenization (OAT)
payload.description: Prefix-decodable causally-ordered action tokens let a VLA policy trade latency for precision at inference; RSS 2026 Outstanding Paper finalist, validated on 3 policy backbones and 60+ tasks.
